# Content Segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContentSegment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A structural part of a creative work, release, or installment — a chapter, section, scene, or episode. A [gufo:Kind](../../external/terms.md#gufo-kind) with distinct identity criteria (position and type within a containing whole).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:NarrativeScope`](gmeow-NarrativeScope.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a structural part of a work — a chapter, section, scene, or episode whose identity is its position and type within a containing whole.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the whole work itself (use the appropriate [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) / [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)) and avoid encoding the segment kind as a subclass — the kind is a [`gmeow:segmentType`](../properties/gmeow-segmentType.md) value ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Type the part [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md), set its kind with [`gmeow:segmentType`](../properties/gmeow-segmentType.md) and order with [`gmeow:segmentIndex`](../properties/gmeow-segmentIndex.md), and attach it to its containing whole via [`gmeow:segmentOf`](../properties/gmeow-segmentOf.md) (inverse [`gmeow:hasSegment`](../properties/gmeow-hasSegment.md)).

### Examples

- ex:chapter1 a [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](gmeow-ContentSegment.md); [`gmeow:segmentType`](../properties/gmeow-segmentType.md) [`gmeow:segmentTypeChapter`](../individuals/gmeow-segmentTypeChapter.md); [`gmeow:segmentIndex`](../properties/gmeow-segmentIndex.md) 1; [`gmeow:segmentOf`](../properties/gmeow-segmentOf.md) ex:novel.
